headline: Japan Core Inflation Accelerates to 2026 Peak on Subsidy Expiry
summary: Japan's core consumer price inflation rose to its highest level this year as energy subsidy expirations pushed up utility costs, coming in slightly below the 2.3% expected by economists.
why: Inflation dynamics in Japan directly affect Bank of Japan monetary policy decisions, influencing national sovereign bond yields and yen exchange rates.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Accelerating inflation increases pressure on the central bank to consider interest rate adjustments.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
